home.hero_sub: Cypherox is an AI and software engineering company. We help German businesses develop AI-powered software, custom digital products and automation and extend their engineering capacity with dedicated developers and technical specialists who work as part of your team.
home.about_title: A Software Engineering Partner for Building, Extending and Modernizing Technology
home.about_lede: Cypherox builds AI-powered software, custom applications and digital products for businesses that need a dependable technology partner. Our teams create new applications, modernize existing systems and integrate automation into daily operations. When internal capacity falls short, dedicated developers and specialists join your team and contribute to product delivery with clear ownership.
home.work_title: Software and AI Projects Built by Our Engineering Teams.
home.work_case1_title: Shopify Store Development: A Faster Store Built for Mobile Buyers
home.work_case1_desc: An online retailer's outdated store had slow pages and a checkout path that lost mobile buyers. Cypherox rebuilt the store on Shopify with a custom theme, streamlined navigation and a simpler mobile checkout flow. The result was a faster store, a smoother mobile buying experience and easier catalog management for the team.
home.work_case2_title: AI Agent Development: Automating Support Requests for a Growing Business
home.work_case2_desc: Support teams spent hours sorting repetitive requests across email and chat. Cypherox built an AI agent that classifies requests, drafts replies from approved knowledge and hands complex cases to staff. The result was faster first responses, fewer manual tasks and more time for agents to focus on complex issues.
home.services_title: AI Development and Software Engineering Services
home.services_lede: Cypherox covers AI, custom software, web, mobile, eCommerce, CMS, automation and UI/UX design. Teams combine these disciplines to build digital products that run reliably in production and fit existing business systems.
home.svc_ai_agent_desc: Design AI agents that handle defined tasks, use your business systems and operate within clear boundaries.
home.svc_gen_ai_desc: Develop generative AI features for content creation, knowledge search and assistants inside your products and internal tools.
home.svc_ai_ml_desc: Build machine learning products and AI applications, covering data preparation, model integration and ongoing maintenance.
home.svc_consulting_desc: Assess your product idea, architecture and delivery options with engineers before committing to a build plan.
home.svc_uiux_desc: Design interfaces and user flows that support usability and a consistent experience across web and mobile products.
home.svc_automation_desc: Automate repetitive business processes and connect systems so teams spend less time on manual work.
home.svc_web_desc: Develop web applications and business platforms using React, Angular, Vue, Node.js, PHP and Python.
home.svc_app_desc: Build iOS, Android and cross-platform mobile apps with Swift, Kotlin, Flutter and React Native.
home.svc_cms_desc: Develop online stores and content platforms on Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, WordPress and Drupal
home.cta_split_title: Hire Dedicated Developers for Your Team
home.cta_split_lede: Extend your engineering team with experienced developers and technical specialists who work to your priorities and processes. Choose the skills and capacity your roadmap needs across mobile, web, AI, DevOps and data analytics and adjust as your product evolves.
home.why_title: Engineering Practices Behind Reliable AI and Software Development
home.why_1_desc: Engineers take part in planning, architecture and delivery decisions, so they discuss technical trade-offs early and reflect them in maintainable code and realistic timelines.
home.why_2_desc: AI solutions are designed around data quality, integration, security and operational requirements so that they can run inside real business processes after the prototype stage.
home.why_3_desc: Start with a defined project or add dedicated developers and technical specialists to your team, then adjust capacity as priorities, budgets and product plans change.
home.why_4_desc: Delivery continues after launch with maintenance, enhancements and technical support, so products remain maintainable and can scale with changing business needs.
home.testimonials_title: What Clients Say About Working With Cypherox
home.testimonials_lede: Feedback from clients on engineering quality, communication and delivery will be featured in this section
home.people_title: Engineers and Technical Specialists Behind Your Development Projects
home.people_lede: 130+ engineers work across AI, software, web, mobile and eCommerce projects. Product-minded engineers and technical specialists collaborate with your stakeholders, review requirements together and build solutions that fit your technology environment and business priorities
home.sched_lede: Tell us whether you want to build an AI or software product or add dedicated developers to your team. We will help you define the next step.
home.faq_lead: Answers to common questions about AI development, software engineering and hiring dedicated developers with Cypherox. Contact us if your question is not covered here.
home.faq1_q: What AI development services does Cypherox offer to German businesses?
home.faq1_a: Cypherox offers AI agent development, generative AI development and AI and machine learning development, alongside consulting and automation services. Teams build AI-powered software that integrates with your existing systems and data. We discuss your use case, technical environment and operational requirements before recommending a project approach.
home.faq2_q: What is the difference between custom software development and hiring dedicated developers?
home.faq2_a: Custom software development means Cypherox takes responsibility for building a product against agreed requirements. Hiring dedicated developers means specialists join your team and work to your priorities and processes. Some businesses combine project development for new products with dedicated developers for ongoing capacity and Cypherox supports both models.
home.faq3_q: Which developers and technical specialists can I hire through Cypherox?
home.faq3_a: You can hire developers for iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native, ReactJS, AngularJS, VueJS, NodeJS, Laravel, Python, PHP and eCommerce platforms such as Shopify, Magento and WooCommerce. Cypherox also provides specialists in DevOps, AWS, AI, ML, data analytics and UI/UX design. Share your requirements and we will match skills to your project.
home.faq4_q: How can a dedicated development team extend our existing engineering capacity?
home.faq4_a: A dedicated development team adds engineers and specialists alongside your internal team. Developers work within your priorities, tools and review processes, so your technical leads keep control of direction. You can start with the skills needed now and adjust team size as workloads, releases, or product plans change.
home.faq5_q: Can Cypherox support software and AI projects for companies in Germany?
home.faq5_a: Yes. Cypherox supports businesses with AI development, software engineering and dedicated developers from offices in Rajkot, Ahmedabad and London. We agree on communication, documentation, security and operational requirements with your team at the start of each engagement, so working arrangements fit your organization.
home.faq6_a: An agency or developer officially vetted by Shopify. It means your store is built to Shopify's standards, not just by someone who's used the platform a few times.
